label: Threads
enables: Posting approved Threads drafts for you, if you turn it on.
connect: Help me connect my brand's Threads account to Fishbowl Studio. Don't ask for my password, don't type it for me and don't store anything: walk me through signing in to threads.net myself, in my own browser (the one Claude in Chrome uses), one step at a time, then check with me which account is open. The studio only notes that it's connected.
post_warning: Posting to Threads by automation may break Meta's terms for Threads, and Meta can restrict the account.
